name: Suspicious parent-child: Office spawning shell
kql: DeviceProcessEvents | where FileName in ('powershell.exe','cmd.exe','wscript.exe','mshta.exe','rundll32.exe','cscript.exe') | where InitiatingProcessFileName in ('winword.exe','excel.exe','powerpnt.exe','outlook.exe')
spl: index=windows sourcetype=Sysmon:ProcessCreation EventCode=1 ParentImage=*\\WINWORD.EXE OR ParentImage=*\\EXCEL.EXE OR ParentImage=*\\OUTLOOK.EXE
tuning: Macros emitting shells are ~always malicious; check for DDE/automation legit uses.
apt: Phishing initial access — APT28, APT29, ALL
